goal: Prove truthful partial deliverable auditing and eliminate old result replay attacks across task version boundaries.
hypothesis: Structured deliverable matrices allow truthful partial progress recording without false overall PASS, and cryptographic task_version nonces prevent result replay.
why_now: Core Section 41-44 requirement for autonomous long-run workflows.
scope: Partial deliverable matrices, task version binding, result replay attack simulation
acceptance_criteria: Partial deliverables yield PARTIAL_PROGRESS with exact sub-deliverable bitmap; result replay across versions rejected.
falsification_criteria: Partial deliverable marked COMPLETE, or old result satisfies new task.
